. label var n1_herdXEApXn12       "Neighbor Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma_{1}$]"

. label var n1_herdXEApXn1234 "Neighbor Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma_{1}$]"

. label var herdXEApXn12          "Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma_{2}$]"

. label var herdXEApXn1234        "Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma_{2}$]"

. 
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "I(Any)"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "I(State)"

. label var ucdp_nonstate_10      "I(Nonstate)"

. label var acled_all_10                  "I(Any)"

. label var acled_state_10                "I(State)"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "I(Nonstate)"

. 
. 
. cap est drop reg*

. foreach x1 in n12 n1234  {
  2. foreach y of varlist $outcome  {
  3.                 
. reghdfe `y'  n1_herdXEApX`x1'  herdXEApX`x1'    ln_pop1990,     vce(cluster cell kg_y) a(year)
  4. 
.                 estadd local ng ""
  5.                 estadd local im ""
  6.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
  7.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
  8.                 estadd ysumm
  9.                 estadd local fe "No"
 10.                 estadd local yfe "Yes"
 11.                 est sto reg`y'
 12.         
.                                 }
 13.                                                           
. esttab  regucdp_all_10  regucdp_state_10  regucdp_nonstate_10  regacled_all_10 regacled_state_10 regacled_nonstate_10  using "$output/REP_TABLE_1_`x1'.tex", replace se  drop(_cons ln_pop
> 1990) ///
>                  star(* 0.100 ** 0.050 *** 0.010) b(%10.4f %10.4f)  nonotes   ///
>                    scalars(  ///
>                     "ymean  \\ Dep. Var. Mean" "yfe Year FE" "clust2 Climate-Zone-Year Clusters" "clust1 Cell Clusters" "N Observations" )  ///
>                         mgroups("UCDP" "ACLED" , pattern(1 0 0 1 0 0 )  ///
>                         prefix(\multicolumn{@span}{c}{) suffix(})  ///
>                         span erepeat(\cmidrule(lr){@span}))  ///
>                  sfmt(   %10.3f  %~12s  ///
>                                   %9.0fc  %9.0fc  %9.0fc )  /// 
>                  label noobs depvar noconstant substitute(\_ _) booktabs
 14. }

(output written to /Users/emcgui01/Dropbox (Nathan Nunn)/Pastoral Conflict/11_replication/output/REP_TABLE_1_n1234.tex)

. 
. 
. **************************************************
. *               TABLE 2
. **************************************************
. 
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var ucdp_nonstate_10      "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_state_10                "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{0}$]" 

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{1}$]"   

. label var g_prec_gpcc                                           "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{2}$]" 

. label var g_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12            "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{3}$]"   

. label var prec_gpcc                                                     "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{4}$]" 

. label var prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12                      "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{5}$]"   

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12  {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $outcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 ,       a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 
.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.                 
. }
 37. esttab regucdp_all_10  regucdp_state_10  regucdp_nonstate_10  regacled_all_10 regacled_state_10 regacled_nonstate_10 using "$output/REP_TABLE_2.tex", drop( _cons) order("\underline{\e
> mph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}" n1_g_`x1' n1_`x1'_X_`x2' "\underline{\emph{Own Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}" g_`x1' g_`x1'_X_`x2' "\underline{\emph{Own Cell}} \
> vspace{-0.4cm}" `x1' `x1'_X_`x2'  ) replace se noconstant  ///
>                  star(* 0.100 ** 0.050 *** 0.010) b(%10.4f %10.4f)  nonotes   ///
>                    scalars( ///
>                                 "ng \\ \underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group: Additional Calculations}} "   ///   
>                                 "im  [1em] Effect of 1 Std. Dev. Rain Shock as $\%$ of Dep. Var. Mean:" ///
>                                 "sdi_nw \hspace{15pt} Rain" "nw_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value" ///

. **************************************************
. *               TABLE 3
. **************************************************
. 
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain"    

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral"      

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 in  herdXEAp  {
  3. foreach x3 in  n12  {
  4. cap est drop reg*
  5. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  6. 
.                 summ `y'
  7.                 loc ymean = r(mean)
  8.                 loneway `x1' cell
  9.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
 10.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'             n1_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'     n1_`x1'_X_`x2'  n1_`x1'_X_`x3'  n1_g_`x1'               ///
>                                         g_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'              g_`x1'_X_`x2'   g_`x1'_X_`x3'   g_`x1'                  ///
>                                         `x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'                `x1'_X_`x2'     `x1'_X_`x3'     `x1'                    ///
>                                         ,       a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
 11.                                 
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 12.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 13.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local ng ""
 15.                 estadd local im ""
 16.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 17.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 18.                 estadd ysumm
 19.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 20.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 21.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 22.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 23.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 24.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 25.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 26.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 27.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 28.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 29.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 30.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 31.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 32.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 33.                 
.                 est sto reg`y'
 34.         
.                                 }
 35.                                 
. esttab regucdp_all_10  regucdp_state_10   regacled_all_10  regacled_nonstate_10   using "$output/REP_TABLE_3.tex", drop( _cons g_`x1' g_`x1'_X_`x2' g_`x1'_X_`x3' g_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3' `x1' 
> `x1'_X_`x2' `x1'_X_`x3' `x1'_X_`x2'X`x3') order( "\underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}" n1_g_`x1'  n1_`x1'_X_`x2' n1_`x1'_X_`x3' n1_`x1'_X_`x2'X`x3'  ) rep
> lace se noconstant  ///
>                  star(* 0.100 ** 0.050 *** 0.010) b(%10.4f %10.4f)  nonotes   ///
>                    scalars( ///
>                                 "ymean  \\ Dep. Var. Mean"  "fe Cell FE" "cy Country $\times$ Year FE" "clust2 Climate-Zone-Year Clusters" "clust1 Cell Clusters" "N Observations" )  ///
>                         mgroups("Indicator for the presence of conflict"  , pattern(1 0 0 0 0 0)  ///
>                         prefix(\multicolumn{@span}{c}{) suffix(})  ///
>                         span erepeat(\cmidrule(lr){@span}))  ///
>                  sfmt( ///
>                                  %10.4f   ///
>                                 %~12s %~12s   %9.0fc  %9.0fc  %9.0fc )  /// 
>                  label noobs  depvar modelwidth(6) substitute(\_ _)     booktabs 
 36.                  
.                                 }
 37.                                 }
 38.                                 }

. **************************************************
. *               TABLE 4
. **************************************************
. 
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{0}$]" 

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{1}$]"

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  5.         
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
. 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 if AG == 1 & !missing( `x2') ,  a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 
.                 est sto reg`y'a
 36.                                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                   if AG == 0  & !missing( `x2')   ,     a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
 37. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
 38.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 39.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 40.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 41.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 42.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 43.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 44.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 45.                 estadd local ng ""
 46.                 estadd local im ""
 47.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 48.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 49.                 estadd ysumm
 50.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 51.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 52.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 53.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 54.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 55.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 56.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 57.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 58.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 59.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")

. **************************************************
. *               TABLE 5
. **************************************************
. 
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. label var n1_g_phytomass        "\hspace{15pt} Phytomass"       

. label var n1_g_temp             "\hspace{15pt} Temperature"

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist phytomass temp {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 
.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.                 
. }
 37. esttab regucdp_all_10 regucdp_state_10 regacled_all_10 regacled_nonstate_10 using "$output/REP_TABLE_5`x1'.tex", drop( _cons g_`x1' g_`x1'_X_`x2' `x1' `x1'_X_`x2') order("\underline{\
> emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}" n1_g_`x1' n1_`x1'_X_`x2'  ) replace se noconstant  ///
>                  star(* 0.100 ** 0.050 *** 0.010) b(%10.4f %10.4f)  nonotes   ///
>                                    scalars( ///
>                                 "ng \\ \underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group: Additional Calculations}} "   ///   
>                                 "im  [1em] Effect of 1 Std. Dev. Shock as $\%$ of Dep. Var. Mean:" ///
>                                 "sdi_nwp [1em] \hspace{15pt} Shock $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral" "nwp_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value" ///
>                                 "ymean \hline \\ Dep. Var. Mean"  "fe Cell FE" "cy Country $\times$ Year FE" "clust2 Climate-Zone-Year Clusters" "clust1 Cell Clusters" "N Observations" )
>   ///
>                         mgroups("Indicator for the presence of conflict"  , pattern(1 0 0 0)  ///
>                         prefix(\multicolumn{@span}{c}{) suffix(})  ///
>                         span erepeat(\cmidrule(lr){@span}))  ///
>                  sfmt(  %~12s ///
>                                 %~12s ///
>                                         %10.2f    %10.2f ///
>                                  %10.3f   ///
>                                 %~12s %~12s   %9.0fc  %9.0fc  %9.0fc )  /// 
>                  label noobs  depvar modelwidth(6) substitute(\_ _) booktabs
 38.                  
. }
 39. }

. label var n1_herdXEApXn12                                       "Transhumant Pastoral"  

. 
. label var       gs_n1_g_phytomass                               "\hspace{15pt} Wet Season Phytomass"

. label var       gs_n1_g_prec_gpcc                               "\hspace{15pt} Wet Season Rain"

. label var       ds_n1_g_phytomass                               "\hspace{15pt} Dry Season Phytomass"

. label var       ds_n1_g_prec_gpcc                               "\hspace{15pt} Dry Season Rain"

. 
. 
. * a. annual
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. cap est drop reg*
  3. foreach y of varlist ucdp_all_10 ucdp2020_num   {
  4.                 
.                 loneway gs_`x1' cell
  5.                 loc gx1sd = r(sd_w)
  6.                 
.                 loneway ds_`x1' cell
  7.                 loc dx1sd = r(sd_w)
  8.                                         
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  9.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
 10. 
. reghdfe gs_`y'          c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12           ///
>                                         c.g_`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                         ///
>                                         c.`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                           ///
>                                         n1_g_`x1'                                                       ///
>                                         g_`x1'                                                  ///
>                                         `x1'                                                            ///
>                                         if seasonal == 1, a(cy cell) cluster(cell kg_y)
 11.         
.                                         estadd local cy "Yes"
 12.                                         estadd local fe "Yes"
 13.                                         estadd local ng " "
 14.                                         estadd local im " "
 15.                                         estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 16.                                         estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 17.                                         estadd ysumm
 18.                                         summ gs_`y' if e(sample)
 19.                                         loc ymean = r(mean)     
 20.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 21.                                         estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 22.                                         test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 23.                                         estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 24.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 25.                                         estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 26.                                         test (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 27.                                         estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 28.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 29.                                         estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 30.                                         test (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 31.                                         estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 32.                                 
.                                         est sto regg`y'
 33.                 
. reghdfe ds_`y'          c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12           ///
>                                         c.g_`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                         ///
>                                         c.`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                           ///
>                                         n1_g_`x1'                                                       ///
>                                         g_`x1'                                                  ///
>                                         `x1'                                                            ///
>                                         if seasonal == 1, a(cy cell) cluster(cell kg_y)
 34.         
.                                         estadd local cy "Yes"
 35.                                         estadd local fe "Yes"
 36.                                         estadd local ng " "
 37.                                         estadd local im " "
 38.                                         estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 39.                                         estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 40.                                         estadd ysumm
 41.                                         summ ds_`y' if e(sample)
 42.                                         loc ymean = r(mean)     
 43.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 44.                                         estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 45.                                         test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `dx1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 46.                                         estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 47.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 48.                                         estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 49.                                         test (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 50.                                         estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 51.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 52.                                         estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 53.                                         test (_b[c.n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 54.                                         estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 55. 
.                                         est sto regd`y'
 56. 
. }

. * b. seasonal 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. cap est drop reg*
  3. foreach y of varlist ucdp_all_10 ucdp2020_num   {
  4.                 
.                 loneway gs_`x1' cell
  5.                 loc gx1sd = r(sd_w)
  6.                 
.                 loneway ds_`x1' cell
  7.                 loc dx1sd = r(sd_w)
  8.                                         
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  9.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
 10. 
.                                         
. reghdfe gs_`y'          c.gs_n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12                ///
>                                         c.gs_g_`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                      ///
>                                         c.gs_`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                                ///
>                                         gs_n1_g_`x1'                                                    ///
>                                         gs_g_`x1'                                                       ///
>                                         gs_`x1'                                                                 ///
>                                         if seasonal == 1, a(cy cell) cluster(cell kg_y)
 11.         
.                                         estadd local cy "Yes"
 12.                                         estadd local fe "Yes"
 13.                                         estadd local ng " "
 14.                                         estadd local im " "
 15.                                         estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 16.                                         estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 17.                                         estadd ysumm
 18.                                         summ gs_`y' if e(sample)
 19.                                         loc ymean = r(mean)     
 20.                                         lincom (_b[gs_n1_g_`x1'] * `gx1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 21.                                         estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 22.                                         test (_b[gs_n1_g_`x1'] * `gx1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 23.                                         estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 24.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[c.gs_n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `gx1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 25.                                         estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 26.                                         test (_b[c.gs_n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `gx1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 27.                                         estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 28.                                         
.                                         lincom (_b[c.gs_n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `gx1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[gs_n1_g_`x1'] * `gx1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 29.                                         estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 30.                                         test (_b[c.gs_n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12] * `gx1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[gs_n1_g_`x1'] * `gx1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 31.                                         estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 32.                                         
.                                         est sto greg`y'
 33.                                         
. reghdfe ds_`y'          c.ds_n1_g_`x1'#c.n1_herdXEApXn12                ///
>                                         c.ds_g_`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                      ///
>                                         c.ds_`x1'#c.herdXEApXn12                                ///

. **************************************************
. *               TABLE 7
. **************************************************
. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain"    

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral"

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist event_jihad_ucdp event_non_jihad  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.                 
. 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_Muslim         `x1'_X_Muslim           n1_`x1'_X_Muslim ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_Christian      `x1'_X_Christian        n1_`x1'_X_Christian ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
 37. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
 38.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 39.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 40.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 41.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 42.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 43.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 44.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 45.                 estadd local ng ""
 46.                 estadd local im ""
 47.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 48.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 49.                 estadd ysumm
 50.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 51.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 52.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 53.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 54.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 55.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 56.                 * estadd sca sdi_nw = (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 57.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 58.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 59.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 60.                 *estadd sca sdi_nwp = (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 61.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 62.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 63.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 64.                 est sto reg`y'1
 65.                                 
.                                 }
 66.                           
. esttab regevent_jihad_ucdp regevent_non_jihad regevent_jihad_ucdp1 regevent_non_jihad1  using "$output/REP_TABLE_7.tex", keep("\underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace
> {-0.4cm}" n1_g_`x1' n1_`x1'_X_`x2'  n1_`x1'_X_Muslim n1_`x1'_X_Christian ) order("\underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}" n1_g_`x1' n1_`x1'_X_`x2'  n1_`x1'_X
> _Muslim n1_`x1'_X_Christian)  replace se noconstant  ///
>                  star(* 0.100 ** 0.050 *** 0.010) b(%10.4f %10.4f)  nonotes   ///
>                    scalars( "ng \\ \underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group: Additional Calculations}} "       ///
>                    "im  [1em] Effect of 1 Std. Dev. Rain Shock as $\%$ of Dep. Var. Mean:" ///
>                    "sdi_nwp [1em] \hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral" "nwp_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value" ///
>                    "ymean \hline \\ Dep. Var. Mean"  "fe Cell FE" "cy Country $\times$ Year FE" "clust2 Climate-Zone-Year Clusters" "clust1 Cell Clusters" "N Observations" )  ///
>                         mgroups("Indicator for presence of conflict"  , pattern(1 0  0  0  0 )  ///
>                         prefix(\multicolumn{@span}{c}{) suffix(})  ///
>                         span erepeat(\cmidrule(lr){@span}))  ///
>                  sfmt(  %~12s %~12s ///
>                                 %10.2f    %10.2f ///
>                                  %10.3f   ///
>                                 %~12s %~12s   %9.0fc  %9.0fc  %9.0fc )  /// 
>                  label noobs  depvar modelwidth(6) substitute(\_ _) booktabs
 67.          
.                                 }
 68.                                 }

. **************************************************
. *               TABLE 8
. **************************************************
. 
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain"    

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral"

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  5.                         
.                                                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'       n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'#c.AD_CORE_TAG  c.n1_g_`x1'#c.AD_CORE_TAG       c.n1_`x2'#c.AD_CORE_TAG         ///
>                                                                                                         c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'#c.AD_CORE_TNG  c.n1_g_`x1'#c.AD_CORE_TNG       c.n1_`x2'#c.AD_COR
> E_TNG         ///
>                                 g_`x1'          g_`x1'_X_`x2'                                   ///
>                                 `x1'            `x1'_X_`x2'                                     ///     
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  6.         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
  7.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
  8.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
  9.                 estadd local ng ""
 10.                 estadd local im ""
 11.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 12.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 13.                 estadd ysumm
 14.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 15.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 16.                 est sto reg`y'
 17. 
.                                 }

. **************************************************
. *               TABLE 9
. **************************************************
. 
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain"    

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral"

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist  herdXEApXn12 {
  3. foreach var of varlist cy_share_ac   {
  4. cap est drop reg*
  5. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  6.                         
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  7.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  8.                 
.                 summ `var' if tag_ctry_y == 1, det
  9.                 loc p10  = r(p10)
 10.                 loc p90  = r(p90)
 11.                                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'     c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'#c.`var' c.n1_g_`x1'#c.`var' c.n1_`x2'#c.`var' n1_`x1'_X_`x2'   n1_g_`x1' ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_`x2'   g_`x1'  ///
>                                 `x1'_X_`x2'             `x1'    ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
 12.         
.                                         
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + c.`var'#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2' * `p10'
 13.                                         estadd sca tot_c10 = r(estimate)
 14.                                         estadd sca tot_s10 = r(se)
 15.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + c.`var'#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2' * `p10' = 0
 16.                                         estadd local tot_p10 = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")  
 17. 
. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + c.`var'#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2' * `p90'
 18.                                         estadd sca tot_c90 = r(estimate)
 19.                                         estadd sca tot_s90 = r(se)
 20.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + c.`var'#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2' * `p90' = 0
 21.                                         estadd local tot_p90 = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")  
 22.                                         
.         
. 
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 23.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 24.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 25.                 estadd local ng ""
 26.                 estadd local im ""
 27.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 28.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 29.                 estadd ysumm
 30.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 31.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp10 = (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[c.`var'#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' * `p10'/ `ymean') * 100           
 33.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp90 = (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[c.`var'#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' * `p90'/ `ymean') * 100
 34.                 
.                 est sto reg`y'
 35. 
.                                 }
 36.                           
. esttab regucdp_all_10 regucdp_state_10 regacled_all_10 regacled_nonstate_10  using "$output/REP_TABLE_9.tex", drop( _cons  n1_g_`x1'  c.n1_g_`x1'#c.`var' c.n1_`x2'#c.`var' g_`x1'_X_`x2' 
> g_`x1' `x1'_X_`x2'  `x1') ///
>         order("\underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}"  n1_`x1'_X_`x2' c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'#c.`var'  ) replace se noconstant  ///
>                  star(* 0.100 ** 0.050 *** 0.010) b(%10.4f %10.4f)  nonotes   ///
>                    scalars( "ng \\ \underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group: Additional Calculations}} " ///
>                    "im \\  Effect of 1 Std. Dev. Rain Shock as $\%$ of Dep. Var. Mean:"  ///
>                    "sdi_nwp10 [1em] \hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral when Protected Area at 10th pctile" ///
>                                     "tot_p10 \hspace{25pt} p-value" ///
>                    "sdi_nwp90 [1em]\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral when Protected Area at 90th pctile" ///
>                                    "tot_p90 \hspace{25pt} p-value" ///
>                    "ymean \hline \\ Dep. Var. Mean"  "fe Cell FE" "cy Country $\times$ Year FE"  "clust2 Climate-Zone-Year Clusters" "clust1 Cell Clusters" "N Observations" )  ///
>                         mgroups("Indicator for presence of conflict"  , pattern(1 0 0 0)  ///
>                         prefix(\multicolumn{@span}{c}{) suffix(})  ///
>                         span erepeat(\cmidrule(lr){@span}))  ///
>                  sfmt(  %~12s ///
>                                 %~12s ///
>                                  %10.1f %10.2f   %10.1f %10.2f ///
>                                  %10.3f  %~12s %~12s  %9.0fc  %9.0fc %9.0fc)  /// 
>                  label noobs  depvar booktabs
 37.                                 }
 38.                                 }
 39. }

. **************************************************
. *               TABLE 10
. **************************************************
. 
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain"    

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral"

. 
. 
. xtset cell year 

Panel variable: cell (strongly balanced)
 Time variable: year, 1985 to 2020
         Delta: 1 unit

. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome   {
  5.                         
. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 summ cy_np_power if tag_ctry_y == 1, det
  8.                 loc p10  = r(p10)
  9.                 loc p90  = r(p90)
 10.                 
.                                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'       n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'#c.lcy_np_power         c.n1_g_`x1'#c.lcy_np_power      c.n1_`x2'#c.lcy_np_power                ///
>                                 g_`x1'          g_`x1'_X_`x2'                                   ///
>                                 `x1'            `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
 11.         
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + c.lcy_np_power#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2' * `p10'
 12.                                         estadd sca tot_c10 = r(estimate)
 13.                                         estadd sca tot_s10 = r(se)
 14.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + c.lcy_np_power#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2' * `p10' = 0
 15.                                         estadd local tot_p10 = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")  
 16. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + c.lcy_np_power#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2' * `p90'
 17.                                         estadd sca tot_c90 = r(estimate)
 18.                                         estadd sca tot_s90 = r(se)
 19.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + c.lcy_np_power#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2' * `p90' = 0
 20.                                         estadd local tot_p90 = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")  
 21.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 22.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 23.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 24.                 estadd local ng ""
 25.                 estadd local im ""
 26.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 27.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 28.                 estadd ysumm
 29.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 30.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 31.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp10 = (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[c.lcy_np_power#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' * `p10'/ `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp90 = (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[c.lcy_np_power#c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' * `p90'/ `ymean') * 100
 33.                 est sto reg`y'
 34.                 
.                                 }
 35.                           
.                                 
. esttab regucdp_all_10 regucdp_state_10 regacled_all_10 regacled_nonstate_10   using "$output/REP_TABLE_10.tex", keep( "\underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.1cm}
> "n1_`x1'_X_`x2' c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'#c.lcy_np_power) order("\underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.1cm}"  n1_`x1'_X_`x2' c.n1_`x1'_X_`x2'#c.lcy_np_power   ) replace s
> e noconstant  ///
>                  star(* 0.100 ** 0.050 *** 0.010) b(%10.4f %10.4f)  nonotes   ///
>                    scalars( "ng \\ \underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group: Additional Calculations}} " ///
>                    "im \\  Effect of 1 Std. Dev. Rain Shock as $\%$ of Dep. Var. Mean:"  ///    
>                         "sdi_nwp10 [1em] \hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral when THP Power at 10th pctile" ///
>                                     "tot_p10 \hspace{25pt} p-value" /// 
>                    "sdi_nwp90 [1em]\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral when THP Power at 90th pctile" ///
>                                    "tot_p90 \hspace{25pt} p-value" ///
>                    "ymean \hline \\ Dep. Var. Mean"  "fe Cell FE" "cy Country $\times$ Year FE"  "clust2 Climate-Zone-Years" "clust1 Cells" "N Observations" )  ///
>                         mgroups("Indicator for presence of conflict"  , pattern(1 0 0 0)  ///
>                         prefix(\multicolumn{@span}{c}{) suffix(})  ///
>                         span erepeat(\cmidrule(lr){@span}))  ///
>                  sfmt(  %~12s ///
>                                 %~12s ///
>                                  %10.1f %10.2f %10.1f %10.2f ///
>                                  %10.3f   ///
>                                 %~12s %~12s  %9.0fc  %9.0fc %9.0fc)  /// 
>                  label noobs  depvar booktabs
 36. }

. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{0}$]" 

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn1234         "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{1}$]"

. label var g_prec_gpcc                                           "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{2}$]" 

. label var g_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn1234          "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{3}$]"   

. label var prec_gpcc                                                     "\hspace{15pt} Rain [$\gamma^{s}_{4}$]" 

. label var prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn1234            "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral [$\gamma^{s}_{5}$]"   

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn1234 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $outcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 ,       a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.

. **************************************************
. *               TABLE A6
. **************************************************
. 
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain"    

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral"      

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_EA_jh  `x1'_X_EA_jh    n1_`x1'_X_EA_jh ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_SL     `x1'_X_SL       n1_`x1'_X_SL ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_EA_gods_4      `x1'_X_EA_gods_4        n1_`x1'_X_EA_gods_4 ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_EA_gods_5      `x1'_X_EA_gods_5        n1_`x1'_X_EA_gods_5 ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.         
.                                 }
 37. 
. esttab regucdp_all_10  regucdp_state_10    regacled_all_10  regacled_nonstate_10 using "$output/REP_TABLE_A6.tex", drop( _cons g* `x1'*) order("\underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethni
> c Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}" n1_g_`x1' n1_`x1'_X_`x2' n1_`x1'_X_EA_jh n1_`x1'_X_SL n1_`x1'_X_EA_gods_4 n1_`x1'_X_EA_gods_5 )  replace se noconstant  ///
>                  star(* 0.100 ** 0.050 *** 0.010) b(%10.4f %10.4f)  nonotes   ///
>                    scalars( "ng \\ \underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group: Additional Calculations}} "          "im  [1em] Effect of 1 Std. Dev. Rain Shock as $\%$ of Dep. Var
> . Mean:" "sdi_nw \hspace{15pt} Rain" "nw_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value" "sdi_nwp [1em] \hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral" "nwp_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value" "sdi_nwnwp [1em]  \
> hspace{15pt} Rain $+$ Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral" "nwnwp_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value"  "ymean \hline \\ Dep. Var. Mean"  "fe Cell FE" "cy Country $\times$ Year FE" "clust2 Climate
> -Zone-Year Clusters" "clust1 Cell Clusters" "N Observations" )  ///
>                         mgroups("Indicator for the presence of conflict" , pattern(1 0 0 0 )  ///
>                         prefix(\multicolumn{@span}{c}{) suffix(})  ///
>                         span erepeat(\cmidrule(lr){@span}))  ///
>                  sfmt(  %~12s %~12s %10.2f    %10.2f %10.2f    %10.2f %10.2f    %10.2f ///
>                                  %10.4f   ///
>                                 %~12s %~12s   %9.0fc  %9.0fc  %9.0fc )  /// 
>                  label noobs  depvar modelwidth(6) substitute(\_ _) booktabs
 38. 
.                                 }
 39.                                 }

. **************************************************
. *               TABLE A7
. **************************************************
. 
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain"    

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral"      

. 
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 g_`x1'_X_g_cm_prec      `x1'm_X_c_m_prec_gpcc   n1_`x1'_X_g_cm_prec01 ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng " "
 17.                 estadd local im " "
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 * estadd sca sdi_nw = (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 *estadd sca sdi_nwp = (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.                         
.                                 }
 37.         
. esttab regucdp_all_10  regucdp_state_10    regacled_all_10  regacled_nonstate_10 using "$output/REP_TABLE_A7.tex", drop( _cons g* `x1'*) order("\underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethni
> c Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}" n1_g_`x1' n1_`x1'_X_`x2' n1_`x1'_X_g_cm_prec01 )  replace se noconstant  ///
>                  star(* 0.100 ** 0.050 *** 0.010) b(%10.4f %10.4f)  nonotes   ///
>                    scalars( "ng \\ \underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group: Additional Calculations}} "          "im  [1em] Effect of 1 Std. Dev. Rain Shock as $\%$ of Dep. Var
> . Mean:" "sdi_nw \hspace{15pt} Rain" "nw_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value" "sdi_nwp [1em] \hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral" "nwp_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value" "sdi_nwnwp [1em]  \
> hspace{15pt} Rain $+$ Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral" "nwnwp_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value"  "ymean \hline \\ Dep. Var. Mean"  "fe Cell FE" "cy Country $\times$ Year FE" "clust2 Climate
> -Zone-Years" "clust1 Cells" "N Observations" )  ///
>                         mgroups("Indicator for the presence of conflict" , pattern(1 0 0 0 )  ///
>                         prefix(\multicolumn{@span}{c}{) suffix(})  ///
>                         span erepeat(\cmidrule(lr){@span}))  ///
>                  sfmt(  %~12s %~12s %10.2f    %10.2f %10.2f    %10.2f %10.2f    %10.2f ///
>                                  %10.4f   ///
>                                 %~12s %~12s   %9.0fc  %9.0fc  %9.0fc )  /// 
>                  label noobs  depvar modelwidth(6) substitute(\_ _) booktabs
 38. 
.                                 }
 39.                                 }

. 
. **************************************************
. *               TABLE A8
. **************************************************                              
.         
. label var ucdp_all_10                   "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(Any)}"

. label var ucdp_state_10                 "\shortstack{ \\ UCDP \\ I(State)}"

. label var acled_all_10                  "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Any)}"

. label var acled_nonstate_10     "\shortstack{ \\ ACLED \\ I(Nonstate)}"

. 
. label var n1_g_prec_gpcc                                        "\hspace{15pt} Rain"    

. label var n1_prec_gpcc_X_herdXEApXn12           "\hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral"      

.                         
. foreach x1 of varlist prec_gpcc  {
  2. foreach x2 of varlist herdXEApXn12 {
  3. cap est drop reg*
  4. foreach y of varlist $shortoutcome  {
  5. 
.                 loneway `x1' cell
  6.                 loc x1sd = r(sd_w)
  7.                 
.                 
. reghdfe `y'     n1_g_`x1'               n1_`x1'_X_`x2'                  ///
>                                 g_`x1'                  g_`x1'_X_`x2'                   ///
>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
>                                 p_energy_X_`x2'         p_energy_X_n1_`x2'      ///
>                                 p_metmin_X_`x2'         p_metmin_X_n1_`x2'      ///
>                                 p_precmet_X_`x2'        p_precmet_X_n1_`x2'     ///
>                                 p_agri_X_`x2'           p_agri_X_n1_`x2'        ///
>                                 year_X_`x2'             year_X_n1_`x2'  ///
>                                  ,      a(cell cy) cluster(cell kg_y) 
  8. 
.                                 lincom n1_`x1'_X_`x2' + n1_g_`x1'
  9.                                         estadd sca tot_nwp = r(estimate)
 10.                                         estadd sca stot_nwp = r(se)
 11.                                         test n1_`x1'_X_`x2' +  n1_g_`x1' = 0
 12.                                         estadd local pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 13.                                         
.                 estadd local ct "Yes"
 14.                 estadd local cy "Yes"
 15.                 estadd local fe "Yes"
 16.                 estadd local ng ""
 17.                 estadd local im ""
 18.                 estadd sca clust1 = e(N_clust1)
 19.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)
 20.                 estadd ysumm
 21.                 summ `y' if e(sample)
 22.                 loc ymean = r(mean)     
 23.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 24.                 estadd sca sdi_nw = r(estimate)
 25.                 test (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 26.                 estadd local nw_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 27.                 * estadd sca sdi_nw = (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 28.                 estadd sca sdi_nwp = r(estimate)
 29.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 30.                 estadd local nwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")         
 31.                 *estadd sca sdi_nwp = (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
.                 
.                 lincom (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100
 32.                 estadd sca sdi_nwnwp = r(estimate)
 33.                 test (_b[n1_`x1'_X_`x2'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 + (_b[n1_g_`x1'] * `x1sd' / `ymean') * 100 = 0
 34.                 estadd local nwnwp_pval = trim("[`:display %9.2f r(p)']")
 35.                 est sto reg`y'
 36.                 
.                                 }
 37.                 
. esttab regucdp_all_10  regucdp_state_10    regacled_all_10  regacled_nonstate_10 using "$output/REP_TABLE_A8.tex", drop( _cons g* `x1'* year_X_`x2' p_*_X_`x2') order("\underline{\emph{Ne
> arest Neighboring Ethnic Group}} \vspace{-0.4cm}" n1_g_`x1' n1_`x1'_X_`x2'  year_X_n1_`x2'    p_*_X_n1_`x2')  replace se noconstant  ///
>                  star(* 0.100 ** 0.050 *** 0.010) b(%10.4f %10.4f)  nonotes   ///
>                    scalars( "ng \\ \underline{\emph{Nearest Neighboring Ethnic Group: Additional Calculations}} "          "im  [1em] Effect of 1 Std. Dev. Rain Shock as $\%$ of Dep. Var
> . Mean:" "sdi_nw \hspace{15pt} Rain" "nw_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value" "sdi_nwp [1em] \hspace{15pt} Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral" "nwp_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value" "sdi_nwnwp [1em]  \
> hspace{15pt} Rain $+$ Rain $\times$ Transhumant Pastoral" "nwnwp_pval \hspace{15pt} p-value"  "ymean \hline \\ Dep. Var. Mean"  "fe Cell FE" "cy Country $\times$ Year FE" "clust2 Climate
> -Zone-Year Clusters" "clust1 Cell Clusters" "N Observations" )  ///
>                         mgroups("Indicator for the presence of conflict" , pattern(1 0 0 0 )  ///
>                         prefix(\multicolumn{@span}{c}{) suffix(})  ///
>                         span erepeat(\cmidrule(lr){@span}))  ///
>                  sfmt(  %~12s %~12s %10.2f    %10.2f %10.2f    %10.2f %10.2f    %10.2f ///
>                                  %10.4f   ///
>                                 %~12s %~12s   %9.0fc  %9.0fc  %9.0fc )  /// 
>                  label noobs  depvar modelwidth(6) substitute(\_ _) booktabs
 38.                                 }
 39.                                 }

  9.                 estadd sca clust2 = e(N_clust2)

.                 est sto reg`y'
 11.                 
. }

>                                 `x1'                    `x1'_X_`x2'                     ///
